    Resources¶

    Every resource class ships both a sync and an async version with an identical method surface -- the async class is always named AsyncX for sync class X.

    Account Campaign Mappings¶

    Account campaign mapping resource: client.account_campaign_mappings.

    AccountCampaignMappings ¶

    AccountCampaignMappings(transport: SyncTransport)

    list ¶

    list(
    email: str,
    *,
    limit: float | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    starting_after: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN
) -> SyncCursorPage[AccountCampaignMapping]

    List campaigns associated with an account email. Auto-paginates.

    AsyncAccountCampaignMappings ¶

    AsyncAccountCampaignMappings(transport: AsyncTransport)

    list async ¶

    list(
    email: str,
    *,
    limit: float | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    starting_after: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN
) -> AsyncCursorPage[AccountCampaignMapping]

    List campaigns associated with an account email. Auto-paginates.

    Accounts¶

    Account resource: client.accounts.

    Accounts ¶

    Accounts(transport: SyncTransport)

    create ¶

    create(
    *,
    email: str,
    first_name: str,
    last_name: str,
    provider_code: float,
    imap_username: str,
    imap_password: str,
    imap_host: str,
    imap_port: float,
    smtp_username: str,
    smtp_password: str,
    smtp_host: str,
    smtp_port: float,
    warmup: Warmup | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    daily_limit: float | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    tracking_domain_name: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    tracking_domain_status: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    enable_slow_ramp: bool | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    inbox_placement_test_limit: (
        float | NotGiven
    ) = NOT_GIVEN,
    sending_gap: float | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    signature: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    reply_to: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    warmup_custom_ftag: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    skip_cname_check: bool | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN
) -> Account

    Connect a new sending account.

    ctd_status ¶

    ctd_status(*, host: str) -> JSONObject

    Get custom tracking domain status for a host.

    daily_analytics(
    *,
    start_date: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    end_date: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    emails: _list[str] | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN
) -> _list[JSONObject]

    Get daily account analytics.

    delete ¶

    delete(email: str) -> Account

    Delete an account.

    disable_warmup(

    filter: JSONObject | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    search: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN
) -> BackgroundJob

    Disable warmup mode for a set of accounts.

    enable_warmup(

    excluded_emails: _list[str] | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    filter: JSONObject | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,

) -> BackgroundJob

    Enable warmup mode for a set of accounts.

    list ¶

    list(
    *,
    limit: int | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    starting_after: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    search: str | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    status: float | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    provider_code: float | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,

    List accounts. Auto-paginates: for a in client.accounts.list(): ....

    pause(email: str) -> Account

    Pause an account.

    resume ¶

    resume(email: str) -> Account

    retrieve(email: str) -> Account

    update(

    ) = NOT_GIVEN,

    inbox_placement_test_limit: (
        float | None | NotGiven
    ) = NOT_GIVEN,
    sending_gap: float | None | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    signature: str | None | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    reply_to: str | None | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    skip_cname_check: bool | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN,
    remove_tracking_domain: bool | NotGiven = NOT_GIVEN

    Partially update an account. Omitted fields are left unchanged.
